scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact for every odd prime \(p\) and all \(a,b\ge1\) within the family \(2^ap^b\); not a classification outside that family. The relevant Reuijl 2026 thesis could not be read in full; bibliographic and OEIS-linked material only was inspected, leaving an originality risk. Finite verification is separate from the mathematical proof of all infinite exponent ranges.
title: Two-prime-support classification of proper-divisor-sum practical numbers
